description: Spec: 006-ci-and-security FR-008, FR-009. Feature 005 pinned everything; this is the mechanism that keeps a pin from becoming a museum piece. Delivered by the Mend-hosted GitHub App, so nothing in this repository holds a token for it. The key is managerFilePatterns, never fileMatch: renamed in Renovate 41, and the validator MIGRATES the old name with a warning and exits 0 rather than refusing it, so scripts/check-ci-contract.sh is what actually catches it (gotcha #7).

pre-commit.description: Off by default. A manager that is off silently is a set of pins nobody is watching.

kubernetes.description: Needs explicit patterns: there is no filename convention it can infer. This is what proposes the image tag bump in deploy/ after release.yml publishes a new version.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates arrive grouped, one change per ecosystem per week, so the number of things to review stays small (FR-009).
A major is a decision, not a bump: it arrives on its own and stays out of the weekly window.

The images this repository publishes DO get proposed in deploy/ — that is the whole chain: release.yml publishes, Renovate sees the newer tag, it proposes the bump, a person merges it, Flux reconciles (SC-005). An earlier version of this file disabled them, which silently broke that chain while the comment three sections up claimed it worked. They are separated from the third-party image group so the proposal is reviewed on its own.
